title: tests.py warns when a whole-suite run uses most of the platform's time ceiling
goal: From the SP-matmvkn6 close retrospective: the whole suite runs 18.6-19.1 s against the 20 s darwin ceiling, so ST-iafyj5f5's check went over on host load and on perfcheck's PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE (fixed in the sprint), and a worker had to diagnose a near-miss. tests.py prints a warning (not a failure) when a whole-suite run takes more than a named share of the ceiling, so the headroom shows before a run goes over.
